Interested in a new job opportunity?   
  Your new company  
 You'll be working with one of Australia's largest local government organisations, supporting critical infrastructure and assets that directly impact the community. 
   
  Your new role  
  Key Responsibilities   
 
 Lead / support detailed design and configuration discussions; specifying details to configure SAP Plant Maintenance Module and its key elements such as Master Data, Transactional Data, Field Mobility and Scheduling. 
 Conduct thorough testing of SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) configurations to identify and resolve any issues or discrepancies 
 Collaborate with peers in the ERP program/platform team to ensure services are co-ordinated and integrated. 
 Collaborate with business and vendors to ensure PP processes and system configurations are fit for purpose against Council's requirements. 
 
  What you'll need to succeed   Mandatory requirements:  
 
 At least 1 full S/4HANA greenfield implementation experience. 
 Demonstrated experience of working in a business function related to Enterprise Asset Management (EAM). 
 Tertiary qualification in a relevant or related discipline. 
 
   
  Required skills and experience:  
 
 Highly skilled in SAP Plant Maintenance 
 Strong communication and collaboration skills 
 At least 8 years of experience in successful implementation or conversion projects in EAM 
 Certification in SAP PM is highly desirable. 
 Demonstrate experience of EAM integration with other modules such as Material Management (MM), Sales and Finance (FICO) 
 Exceptional stakeholder engagement, influencing and management skills - understanding how others think and act - ability to smoothly deliver outcomes through strong business, team, and supplier partnerships. 
 
   
  What you'll get in return  
 
 Opportunity to work on a significant SAP S/4HANA transformation program. 
 Exposure to complex Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) and Plant Maintenance processes. 
 Ability to influence the future-state solution rather than simply supporting an existing environment. 
 End-to-end project involvement including design, testing, deployment and continuous improvement. 
 
  What you need to do now

result.description: Beforepay   Security Monitoring and Incident Response    Monitor security events, alerts, and logs generated from security monitoring platforms and infrastructure.  Investigate and analyse cybersecurity incidents and suspicious activities to determine the root cause and potential impact.  Document incident findings and recommend remediation actions to reduce security risks.  Support incident response activities and coordinate remediation efforts where required.    Vulnerability and Patch Management    Perform vulnerability assessments across endpoints, infrastructure, and application environments.  Identify and track security vulnerabilities across systems, repositories, and network infrastructure.  Assist in patch management and remediation processes to reduce exposure to security threats.    Security Infrastructure and Platform Administration    Implement, configure, and maintain security tools and platforms, including Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Unified Endpoint Management (UEM), and cloud security monitoring tools such as AWS Security Hub.  Monitor the security posture of cloud and internal environments to ensure systems remain secure and compliant.  Coordinate with external vendors and service providers for security platform maintenance and improvements.    Governance, Risk and Compliance    Assist in developing and maintaining information security policies, procedures, and standards.  Support implementation and maintenance of security frameworks, including ISO 27001.  Maintain security documentation, operational runbooks, and audit evidence to support compliance requirements.  Conduct security risk assessments and recommend mitigation strategies.    Security Awareness and Training    Deliver cybersecurity awareness training programs across the organisation.  Promote security best practices and assist in maintaining security awareness platforms and training materials.    Continuous Security Improvement    Conduct periodic security reviews of systems and infrastructure.  Recommend improvements to strengthen security controls and operational resilience.  Evaluate emerging security technologies and tools to enhance organisational security capabilities.    Required Skills    Cybersecurity monitoring and incident investigation  Vulnerability assessment and remediation  Cloud security monitoring and infrastructure security  Security platform administration (EDR, UEM, cloud security tools)  Compliance platform administration  Risk assessment and security control implementation  Information security governance and compliance  Security documentation and policy development    Qualifications and Experience    Master’s degree in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.  Experience working in information security, cybersecurity operations, or security risk management roles.  Experience with security monitoring tools, vulnerability management, and cloud environments is desirable.  Relevant certifications are advantageous   About Company    Beforepay, an ASX-listed fintech pioneer, is on a mission to revolutionise the financial industry with safe and affordable products. Our core philosophy is grounded in providing ethical short-term loans as a viable alternative to predatory lending practices. This commitment to integrity and customer well-being has earned us prestigious accolades such as the Ethical Lender of the Year 2023 by Wealth & Finance International FinTech Awards and Global Pan Finance Awards, and the Best App-Based Lending Company 2023 in Australia by APAC Insider Business Awards.  Our journey of innovation and ethical service was further recognised with our inclusion in the Tech Fast 50 2023 by Deloitte and our early accolade as the Ashurst FinTech Startup of the Year in 2020. As a team member of Beforepay, you'll join a trailblazing company that not only sets the pace in the fintech industry but also upholds the highest standards of ethical lending, providing a meaningful and impactful career. MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Your Role as Finance Business Partner

As a Finance Business Partner, you'll work closely with operational leaders to deliver financial insights, performance analysis and strategic advice that supports informed decision-making.

You will play a key role in ensuring strong financial management across both corporate and service delivery functions, contributing to business sustainability, innovation and growth.

Key responsibilities include:

Partner with leaders to provide financial advice and insights that support informed decision-making.

Develop financial models, scenario analysis and cost-benefit assessments to evaluate strategic opportunities.

Turn complex financial and operational data into clear, practical recommendations.

Support business planning, performance reviews and investment decisions with trusted financial guidance.

Lead budgeting and forecasting activities, ensuring forecasts are accurate, evidence-based and aligned with organisational goals.

Prepare monthly performance reports, including KPI tracking, variance analysis and key business insights.

Assist with business cases for new programs, service expansions and tender opportunities.

Improve financial systems, reporting and data quality while supporting compliance, audits and governance requirements.

What We Offer

Salary packaging benefits: boost your take-home pay by up to $18,550 annually through not-for-profit tax concessions

Wellbeing Support: Access discounts on private health insurance and gym memberships, and free, confidential counselling through our employee assistance program.

Flexible working: opportunities with hybrid (office-WFH) options

What We're Looking For

A degree in Accounting or Finance, with CA-CPA qualification (or equivalent).

Proven experience in FP&A, management accounting or business partnering roles.

Strong skills in financial modelling, budgeting, forecasting and reporting.

The ability to build trusted relationships and influence stakeholders at all levels.

Excellent communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex information.

Experience using ERP systems and reporting tools (e.g. Excel, Power BI, TechOne or similar).

Strong analytical capability and attention to detail.

A Valuable Addition, Yet Not a Must-Have!

Experience in not-for-profit, healthcare, aged care or government-funded environments.

Exposure to business case development or transformation initiatives.

Experience in multi-portfolio or complex organisations.

Essential Requirements

Proof of COVID-19 vaccination status (or as required by legislation and WMQ policy)

Relevant probity checks required by legislation and WMQ Limited policy.

Current Driver's Licence and willingness to travel for work

Apply Now!

Be part of something meaningful - Click Apply today!

Partner with purpose. Drive impact through insight.

At Wesley Mission Queensland, we believe in creating meaningful change in the lives of individuals, families and communities. We are seeking a Finance Business Partner to join our team and play a key role in supporting strategic decision-making, financial performance and sustainable service delivery across our Corporate Services and Living Well portfolios.

This is a highly visible, collaborative role where your work will directly influence outcomes across critical community programs.    Click here to Apply now →
